register.labelZh: MATCH 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: MATCH 片語動詞可以說明某人或某隊被安排與哪一方比賽。；當兩個人或事物互相適合時,可以使用 match somebody/something with somebody/something。；match something against something 適合用來核對姓名、數字、照片、表格和電腦紀錄。；match up 可以表示說法、日期、總額和其他細節是否相符。
register.summaryEn: MATCH expressions can explain who has been chosen to play against another person or team. You can use match somebody or something with another person or thing when they suit each other. Match something against something is useful when checking names, numbers, photographs, forms and computer records. Match up can show whether stories, dates, totals and other details are the same or consistent.
register.formalZh: 閱讀整句,選出意思相同的 MATCH 片語動詞。
register.formalEn: Read the whole sentence and choose the MATCH expression that gives the same meaning.

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. In a competition, match somebody against or with somebody means arranging for them to compete: match our team against the champions match our team with the champions Match up can be used alone or followed by with: The two totals match up.
